value: Defra (2012). Green Food Project: Dairy Sub Group Report. PB13796. Department for Environment, Food and Rural Affairs, London, July 2012.

Policy and stakeholder report on sustainable intensification of UK dairy farming and processing (feed, grazing, herd health, emissions, processing, retail). No technology-level numbers. Numbers it has (p.43): UK dairy processing used 3,711,588 MWh in the previous year, 380 kWh per tonne throughput, 30% lower energy intensity than 1998; subsector ranges of PRIMARY energy: liquid milk 80-300, cheese 295-680, mixed dairy incl. powder 142-1100 kWh/t throughput. Refers to the Carbon Trust IEEA dairy guide (CTG033) but does not reproduce it; answers no to-get row (sibling only).
